# `Object.getPrototypeOf`

The `Object.getPrototypeOf` intrinsic, robustly cached. If it doesn't exist, it exports null.

## Usage

```js
const $getPrototypeOf = require("object.getprototypeof-x")
const assert = require("assert")

assert($getPrototypeOf === Object.getPrototypeOf)
```

null logic:
```js
delete Object.getPrototypeOf

console.log("object.getprototypeof-x") // null
